legal_basis.regulation_observation: CMS deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program to be in compliance with Part 180.
legal_basis.statute_observation: An Indian Health Program includes any health program administered directly by the Indian Health Service.

interpretation: The exact live CMS CCN record and current CMS Service Locator and IHS facility page agree on the Hopi Health Care Center identity and Polacca location; the CMS Service Locator lists IHS affiliation. Current IHS service-unit evidence and its federally-operated-facility dashboard support direct IHS program operation, which is within the Indian Health Program exception in 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2), read with 25 USC 1603(12)(A). CMS's separate Tribal ownership value is preserved rather than silently reconciled. This is a scope classification only; it does not establish pointer linkage, current MRF availability, absence, or file quality. The prior 2026-09-21 pointer-discovery uncertainty remains as historical provenance, not an active HPT requirement under this scope classification.
